application_review: PROGRESS. The preceding mixed-dual-multiplication baseline is retained. Retained proof source hashes and axiom sets are checked unchanged.
A multiplier is an actual unit-bounded family whose Hilbert image lies in the closed dual subspace. Its cellwise values need not lie in the mixed-dual convex hull.

For a scaled-hull input, commutativity of actual multiplication exchanges the roles of multiplier and input. The previously verified hull-multiplier theorem then proves membership of the product in the closed subspace.
Scaled-hull approximation and the actual Hilbert contraction extend product membership to every represented vector of that closed subspace. Closedness is used explicitly.
The actual inner-product symmetry transfers product closure to preservation of the orthogonal complement. Projection uniqueness then gives the pull-out identity for actual representatives.

All four results concern the same subgroup system and degree. No commutation of different subgroup projections, factor localization, high-order concatenation or full Bessel theorem is inferred. The main target remains unproved.
remaining: The common-system master estimates, first-order Bessel, dual energy reduction, recursion and stability are proved. Actual dual functions now have a common finite empirical approximation preserving arbitrary cell probabilities, unit bounds and uniform bounded-test correlations. Exact arbitrary-vertex reflection of the actual subgroup cube law and mixed products is now proved. Mixed cubes now have exact arbitrary-vertex duality and weighted single-vertex replacement estimates. Finite products of dual functions now have quantitative empirical approximation uniform over bounded tests. Exact translated-product expansions and extraction for each fixed test are now proved. The exact mixed face split, projected-face correlation and one-step face Cauchy-Schwarz inequality are now proved. Face energies are now identified with actual copied cube means, with nonnegativity and copy algebra verified. Arbitrary-coordinate permutation invariance, copied-mean nonnegativity and reflection bounds are now established. Full multidimensional mixed Gowers Cauchy-Schwarz, the product-root bound and the single-vertex bound are now proved. Actual dual anti-uniformity, its weighted version and the finite zero-root orthogonality characterization are now proved. Mixed dual recursion, covariance and exact subgroup-shift expansions are now established. Same-subgroup mixed-dual finite products now have an exact averaged dual representation and retain weighted anti-uniformity. The actual unit-input mixed-dual convex hull now has multiplicative and translation closure with unchanged weighted anti-uniform bounds. For varying finite groups and cell types, the exact weighted Haar Hilbert realization and vanishing-Gowers/closed-dual-span orthogonality equivalence are now proved. The dual Hilbert span now has uniformly bounded scaled-hull representatives dense in its closure; their bound may depend on the approximation. Fixed-polynomial and continuous functional calculus for scaled-hull representatives, their clipping closure, and unit-interval-valued approximation of the actual dual Hilbert projection are now proved. The actual dual projection now controls the limiting Gowers power and yields unit-interval models with arbitrarily small Gowers error along the same ultrafilter. For ultrafilters containing every tail, diagonalization now provides one exact unit-interval representative of the dual projection and residual Gowers convergence to zero. Actual unit mixed-dual-hull multiplication now preserves the closed dual space and its orthogonal complement and satisfies the genuine projection pull-out identity on represented inputs. Every unit-bounded actual representative in the closed mixed-dual subspace now multiplies that subspace and its orthogonal complement into themselves. The genuine projection pull-out identity extends to these structured multipliers without requiring cellwise convex-hull membership. Higher-order concatenation controlling dual correlations and the full qualitative Bessel theorem remain missing, as do remaining replica integration, cyclic-to-interval transfer and inverse correlator existence. Coloring-derived targets, Calibration/Alignment and final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction remain. StrongConjecture is unchanged and unproved. No unavoidable blocker is established; publication, PR and prize application remain pending.
